blurb: Guests can take scenic float plane or helicopter flights to explore Clayoquot Sound, Hot Springs Cove, glaciers, and remote wilderness areas. Float plane tours include wildlife viewing and landings at mountain lakes. Charter flights are available for custom trips and transportation needs.
